instruction: Open desktop settings and enable screen blanking, setting the timeout to 10 minutes of inactivity.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling screen blank by setting idle-delay to 10 minutes (600 seconds). The evaluator uses gsettings to read the idle-delay value and expects it to be 'uint32 600\n' (10 minutes). This is the same setting as the original task but with a different target value (600 instead of 0).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads the org.gnome.desktop.session idle-delay setting using gsettings command
Expected value 'uint32 600\n' correctly represents 10 minutes (600 seconds) in gsettings output format
Metric exact_match is appropriate for comparing gsettings output which has a precise format
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement - idle-delay set to 10 minutes
State is accessible: gsettings can be queried after task completion to verify the setting
Data flow is correct: getter extracts idle-delay value -> metric performs exact match comparison -> verification succeeds if value equals 'uint32 600\n'
